ACT XXVII OF 2018
ACT XXVII OF 2018
SINDH SPORTS BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Sports Board Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-14/2018,
dated 22.5.2018.--The Sindh Sports
Board (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 18th April, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th May,
2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Sports Board Ordinance, 1980, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 4 of the Sindh Ordinance No. VIII of 1980
